note: Merchant connector registry. Affiliate IDs live here (config), never in product records or page markup. graph.js builds outbound affiliate links from a product's {merchant, merchantRef} plus this config, so swapping an affiliate ID or adding a network is a one-line config change.

amazon.name: Amazon
amazon.notes: ref = ASIN. Use OneLink for geo-routing later.

etsy.name: Etsy
etsy.notes: ref = Etsy listing ID, wrapped through Awin deep link.

ebay.name: eBay
ebay.notes: ref = eBay item ID. Good fit for rare/retired collectibles.

shopify-partner.name: Boutique partners
shopify-partner.notes: ref = full partner product path (domain + path). Direct rev-share partnerships with indie cute-goods stores.
